# Salih Kilic

> Personal site and blog of Salih A. Kilic, a data management and engineering specialist working with Python, SQL, and SAS. Find his CV, projects, and writing on data and technology here.

This is the personal site of Salih Kilic (https://salihkilic.net), covering data management/engineering work, projects, and writing. The site is available in English and Turkish; language variants live under `/{lang}/` path prefixes (see hreflang alternates on each page).

## Key pages

- [About](https://salihkilic.net/): background, current focus, and contact/social links
- [CV](https://salihkilic.net/cv/): full curriculum vitae
- [Projects](https://salihkilic.net/projects/): selected work
- [Publications](https://salihkilic.net/publications/): papers and citations
- [Blog](https://salihkilic.net/blog/): posts on data engineering, analysis, and tooling
- [Repositories](https://salihkilic.net/repositories/): open-source and code repositories

## Notes for automated readers

- Canonical URLs, hreflang alternates, and Schema.org JSON-LD (Person / WebSite / BlogPosting) are present on every page.
- A sitemap is available at https://salihkilic.net/sitemap.xml.
- robots.txt at https://salihkilic.net/robots.txt allows all crawlers, including AI/answer-engine bots.
